items.title: ARC-029: within-run committed vs uncommitted harm contrast under threshold-modulated mode alternation (variance-tracking commit bar, precision-invariant ablation)
items.note: ARC-029 (EXP-1394): within-run committed vs uncommitted HARM contrast under threshold-modulated mode alternation on the variance-tracking commit bar (precision-invariant ablation). Supersedes V3-EXQ-063a (non_contributory by confirmed autopsy 2026-09-14; that driver wrote agent.e3._running_variance directly, confounding commitment with precision, and its occupancy was forced -- vacuous non-degeneracy). This driver never assigns to e3._running_variance (source-level invariant, asserted at runtime and gated as G1). Mode driver is threshold-side only: base bar = use_variance_tracking_commit_threshold (q=0.50 quantile of detrended commit-gate-variance residuals, pre-registered per the build record's measured surface), alternation = MECH-108 BreathOscillator multiplying the bar by (1 - sweep_amplitude) during the sweep phase. ONE agent trained per seed (P0=30 + P1=60 = 90 episodes, 120 steps/episode); both arms (ARM_STATIC: bar armed, breath_period=0; ARM_ALTERNATE: + MECH-108 sweep at the seed's calibrated amplitude) then run on that same trained agent so G1 isolates the manipulation from training noise. sweep_amplitude is calibrated per seed on held-out episodes from the ladder {0.02, 0.05, 0.10}, choosing the largest rung clearing occupancy/run-length/precision-invariance bands, then re-evaluated on disjoint measured episodes. 5 seeds [0, 42, 100, 123, 200] (ARC-029/125a's set), MIN_SEEDS_PASSING=4. Gates (all three must hold before C1 is read as evidence): G0_occupancy (committed_step_fraction in [0.15,0.85] and mean committed-run length >= 3 on >=4/5 seeds), G1_precision_invariance (|delta mean log10 precision| <= 0.20 decades), G2_min_harm_events (>= 10x the 1/N measurement floor). C1 criterion: max(0.5*SD(delta), 0.002) absolute floor on the committed-vs-uncommitted harm delta. Red-team (fable) resolved for this design; if a gate fails to clear cleanly the run is recorded non_contributory per ARC-029's own text, not evidence. Landed by serial queue burn-down 2026-09-20; script was tracked-but-unqueued.

items.title: MECH-266/SD-032a: squash-vs-clamp affinity bounding-operator cap sweep with gain-matched control arm (diagnostic)
items.note: Validates mode-governance-engagement ITEM (1) (the affinity bounding operator) ONLY; items (2) commitment-term grading and (3) production default remain OPEN and are untouched. DIAGNOSTIC (excluded from confidence scoring). PROMOTES NOTHING -- MECH-266 / SD-032a pending_retest_after_substrate holds, and the Stage-H nav-competence dependency gating v3_exq_464d/467d is untouched. DESIGN: crosses the affinity bounding OPERATOR with the cap at EVAL time on clones of one trained curriculum agent per seed (cap, mode and sigma all read live at SalienceCoordinator.tick()). THREE bound arms x CAP_SWEEP [0.75,1.0,1.25,1.5,1.75] x 2 rail arms x 3 seeds [42,43,44] = 30 cells/seed: clamp_baseline (w=3.0, the V3-EXQ-934 baseline design), squash (sigma=cap default), and clamp_gain_matched (clamp operator, w'(cap)=3.0*(cap/(cap+1))/min(1,cap)) -- the ATTRIBUTION CONTROL added by USER DECISION 2026-09-19T23:52:40Z OPTION A. Training held at cap 2.0 under the clamp (464e/934 construction). Seeds 42-44 kept deliberately (934's; its seed 44 guard-PASSED with the highest contact rate, 0.3064). LOAD-BEARING DV: occupancy -- the squash arm's ARM_SYMMETRIC gate via experiments/_lib/regime_occupancy_gate.py, GRADED iff >=2 CONSECUTIVE cap values each mixed in (0.1,0.9) on >=2/3 seeds. Bar TRANSCRIBED from the entry's own failure_record target, never re-derived; gate called ONCE per (bound_arm, rail_arm) over ALL (seed,cap) cells with seed AND sweep_value populated -- NOT 934's per-seed call shape, which is what produced its false routing. The continuous margin is RECORDED AS TELEMETRY WITH NO THRESHOLD (user decision): no numeric threshold for the squash-vs-clamp contrast is registered anywhere. WHY THE THIRD ARM: red-team pass 1 (fable) returned BLOCKING, verified against source -- the operator is applied to EVERY affinity_weights signal (salience_coordinator.py:616-636) including the [0,1]-bounded external_task_drive (agent.py:2760-2765, w=3.0), and at sigma=cap the squash returns 0.500x AT the cap, so clamp->squash moved the external_task logit by -0.96..-1.50 while the dacc_pe degeneracy fix under test moved its logit by only -0.034..-0.173 (8x-28x confound). With two arms neither a PASS nor the null was attributable. GFLAG-0370 records this and also that the why_sigma_equals_cap rationale in the substrate entry does not hold as written. RED-TEAM pass 1 (fable): BLOCKING -> resolved by user OPTION A. RED-TEAM pass 2 (fable, licensed re-spawn since the manipulation changed): CONTESTED, 4 findings, ALL reproduced against source and FIXED -- (F1) the (squash NOT graded, gain_matched graded) cell was unrouted and recorded a false 'no_arm_graded' reason with SD-032a weakens, now its own branch -> gain/non_contributory; (F2) the gain match holds only at engagement e=1.0, so 'the control did not grade' could be over-cutting rather than gradedness -- a false-positive path to supports; cells now record REALIZED drive contribution under all three arm definitions and the gradedness attribution is gated on gain_match_valid (residual < the gain cut it reproduces; boundary definitional, not tuned); (F3) 'occupancy static across arms' was attributed to the item-(2) latch unconditionally, now requires et_sat_mean>0 since engagement near zero produces the same reading; (F4) INHERITED FROM V3-EXQ-934 -- the external_task_drive_engages precondition cannot see a dead drive: measured, with the drive signal at EXACTLY 0.0 the margin still reads 0.3287-0.4950, 6.6x-9.9x the 0.05 floor, because it is floored by external_task_bias=1.0; added external_task_drive_signal_nonzero (a zero-test on the drive's own value). F4 is worth governance attention on its own account. PAIRING: cells are RNG- AND ENV-paired across bound arms (per-cell seed derives from (seed,cap,rail_arm) only, driving reset_all_rng and a fresh per-cell env), bound arm nested INNERMOST -- fixes the vacuous 1e-6 non-degeneracy guard (banked 934 cells differing only in rails already differed by 1.7e-3) and the shared-stateful-env order confound. GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout = per-cap occupancy under salience_affinity_bound_mode='squash'; that mode landed 2026-09-19 and NO recorded manifest has ever set it (934/935/935a are all clamp-only), so the readout is absent from every banked run -> must run, not reanalyzable. RE-DERIVE BRAKE: MECH-266/SD-032a count=7 but RELEASED -- the named upstream substrate (mode-governance-engagement item (1), cingulate.salience_coordinator.affinity_bound_operator) shows IMPLEMENTED 2026-09-19 in ree-v3/CLAUDE.md; and this is a new EXQ number testing a different mechanism (the operator family) as a diagnostic discriminating WHY the ceiling holds, which Step 2.5b exempts independently. STEP 2.5c: no open 'corrupting' substrate_queue entry overlaps this driver's modules (mode-governance-engagement itself is severity=cosmetic). Runs under these open 'degrading' entries, recorded as known limitations: SD-018 and SD-106 (agent.py::compute_resource_proximity_loss, latent/stack.py), sd061-resume-progress-ecology (causal_grid_world.py::CausalGridWorldV2.step), SD-091 (agent.py::REEAgent.select_action), SD-MECH303-THRESHOLD-SOURCING (config.py, causal_grid_world.py, agent.py), SD-ZWORLD-SENSE-PATH-PARITY (agent.py::REEAgent.sense). SMOKE: PASS (rc=0) -- 12 cells (3 arms x 2 caps x 2 rails), denominator ep N/45, 1 verdict line, gain-matched weights exact (1.714286 at cap 0.75, 1.5 at cap 1.0); a guard-passing run exercised the full analysis path and landed on the new F3 branch (et_drive_mean=0.7256, et_sat=0.0 -> static_but_latch_not_implicated, non_contributory), which pre-fix would have recorded SD-032a weakens against a latch that never fired. validate_experiments --strict: 38/38 OK. Successor to V3-EXQ-934; NOT a supersede -- 934 measured the clamp across the same band and that reading stands.

items.title: ARC-029 P1/P3 joint-feasibility env operating-point sweep (diagnostic, tick-budget repair)
items.note: DIAGNOSTIC, no claim verdict. SUPERSEDES V3-EXQ-1070, which RAN (2026-09-20T04:26Z, 211 min) and correctly gated itself out: outcome FAIL, label substrate_not_ready_requeue, on ONE of four preconditions -- training_tick_budget_equalised 3.96 vs a 2.0 ceiling. Same scientific question, same pre-registered criteria and thresholds, ONE instrument repair. WHAT 1070 ALREADY SETTLED (not re-derived): bar_in_force 1.000 and the commit window filled in 30/30 cells, so the ORIGINAL predecessor's bar_in_force 0.000 / occupancy 1.0000 reading was a WARM-BUDGET artifact, not an env property; rv collapsed 1.27 decades at the worst cell; the episode-boundary fix mattered (run length 4.4-8.1 per-episode vs 17.8-31.3 flat); the health-budget product tightened to 1.159-1.259 on a trained agent; and the owed rv residual dispersion rises monotonically 0.0112->0.0672 across the ladder. ROOT CAUSE of the failure: 1070 sized each rung's EPISODE budget from a RANDOM-POLICY episode-length table. Realised/predicted was 0.82-1.22 at L0/L1 but 0.35-0.70 at L2/L3/L5, so the soft rungs under-trained (per-rung mean ticks 1294/1736/685/614/668), and realised ticks also varied up to 2x BETWEEN SEEDS at one rung. TWO cheaper fixes were checked against 1070's own numbers and rejected in the docstring so they are not re-proposed: re-deriving the table gives ~2.0 (no margin, and blind to seed variance), and gating on the per-rung mean gives 2.83 and relaxes the precondition. THE RULE: per (rung, seed) a TWO-STAGE PILOT runs the identical trainer on a throwaway agent at the same seed -- stage A measures P0 ticks/episode, stage B carries that agent through a FULL-LENGTH P0 and then measures P1 ticks/episode at the point the real P1 actually starts -- and the real agent is trained in exactly ONE _train_all_on_agent call sized from it. ONE call because the trainer builds its optimizers internally, so a chunked tick cap would reset Adam more often at the short-episode rungs, re-introducing a training-dynamics difference along the manipulated dimension while removing a tick-count one. The zworld P0a phase stays budgeted from the random-policy table on purpose (run_zworld_p0 rolls out under RandomPolicy) -- conflating the two is what 1070 got wrong. RED-TEAM (Step 4.5, Fable; this session on Opus): CONTESTED, 6 findings, all verified against source or against 1070's own manifest, all FIXED, none dismissed. The most valuable: the drop rule can only ever remove a SHORT-episode rung, which is the ladder's MINIMUM and the lineage control -- on 1070's own rung means, dropping L0 moves D1's range from 3.32 to 1.94, so ungated a BUDGET failure would have reported as 'the ladder did not sweep' while the label still named a feasibility region. A drop is now GATED (all_rungs_tick_budgetable) and routes to substrate_not_ready_requeue; regression-tested by replaying 1070's rows with L0 marked infeasible. Also fixed: the pilot's own rung-correlated error (two-stage), the pilot env using an offset seed (env RNG is per-instance, so the offset bought nothing and cost the seed half of 'closed-loop'), pilot RNG bleeding into the real training call (pilot now runs first), and the progress denominator on the capped path. DECLARED NOT FIXED because it is structural: equal TICKS is not equal REINFORCE updates -- those heads step per P1 EPISODE, so their count varies ~5x inversely with episode length; ticks = episodes x length, so no budget equalises both. Read the deliverable as 'is there a region', not 'which rung is best'. GOV-REUSE-1: the decisive readout is 1070's own, and 1070 did not report it -- its gate failed, and the numbers it did produce came from exactly the unequal budgets this iteration removes. Not recoverable by reanalysis -> run. Smoke PASS (rc=0, sentinel written, dry-run manifest relocated, validate_recording --strict complete, validate_experiments --strict OK). ESTIMATE: 400 min; 1070 took 211 min at lower load, and this adds a two-stage pilot (~1.8x the training ticks). ree-cloud-4 was at load ~8 on 2 vCPUs while this was authored, so the wall clock may run well over.

items.title: MECH-017 additive-budget DOSE LADDER on the final consolidation pass (diagnostic)
items.note: RATIFIED SUCCESSOR. GOV-FANOUT-1 probe 1 from the CONFIRMED cluster autopsy failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-1057-1057a-cluster_2026-09-20 (ratified by /governance cycle governance-20260920, REE_assembly 108b156192). The autopsy REFUSED a third sequential-pass letter and ordered the dose ladder FIRST; the user's Step-8 gate (AskUserQuestion, 2026-09-20) selected 'One last letter, 1057b', which is why this is a LETTER and not a new number -- left to the EXQ versioning heuristic alone this would have argued for a new number, and the human choice outranks it. DESIGN: after a FIXED pass, the LAST pass at the FINAL of 4 consolidation points runs k in {0,3,6,12,24} steps; the first 3 points run the full unchanged additive construction. Both orders (ORDER_WR doses the recent window = 1057's D1 lineage; ORDER_RW doses the whole buffer = 1057a's D2 lineage, the MIRROR), plus ARM_A/ARM_B/ARM_C. 13 arms x 5 seeds. Null (the autopsy's): both curves flat in k. PURPOSE IS `diagnostic`, DELIBERATELY AND UNLIKE ITS PREDECESSORS (1057/1057a were `evidence`): the load-bearing criterion is the SHAPE of a dose curve on a consolidation SCHEDULE and neither its PASS nor its FAIL makes MECH-017 more or less likely, so scoring it into MECH-017's confidence would corrupt it. The autopsy's own debt_class for this node is 'complex (probe-gated)', and CLAUDE.md's vocabulary makes a probe on such a node a diagnostic. Every verdict branch records non_contributory by design. A REVIEWER WHO DISAGREES CHANGES ONE LINE (EXPERIMENT_PURPOSE). RETENTION GATES KEPT BUT NEVER GATING, per routing_detail 'Both retention gates kept': both are computed in their 1048/1057/1057a form at EVERY ladder rung, giving a retention DOSE-RESPONSE instead of a single pass/fail. Gating them would be a pre-registered GUARANTEED failure (ARM_D1_K24 reproduces the order 1057 measured at 0/5), is structurally meaningless at k=0, and would gate away the dependent variable -- the exact precedent V3-EXQ-1057a set for ARM_D1. ANCHORING, stated because the pre-flight got it half wrong: k=24 reproduces 1057a's ARM_D1/ARM_D2 construction EXACTLY (so a departure from the recorded 1.74e-04 / 7.48e-05 early means is harness drift), but k=0 does NOT reproduce ARM_A -- it still runs the dosed pass at the non-final points. ARM_A/B/C are carried in-run so the ladder has in-run anchors. RED-TEAM (Step 4.5, model fable -- cross-model from this session's Opus 5): CONTESTED, 7 findings, all verified against source, 6 FIXED and 1 DECLARED. F1 (the serious one): at k=0 the dosed pass does not run, so each order sits in its MIRROR's last-writer state and the last-writer hypothesis predicts OPPOSITE-sign curves -- the first classifier had no branch for that and would have recorded the strongest confirmation of H-schedule as 'undetermined'; fixed, and the docstring prediction corrected. F4: endpoint-only non-flatness certifies 'flat' on a curve whose interior moved; fixed to test EVERY rung (no new constant, and more faithful to the ratified null) -- the re-smoke demonstrated it live on D2_late. F5/F6: dose_reaches_dv is vacuous as an aliasing guard under live probe dropout, and the 0.8% noise band was a toy-scale number; a new flat_band_exceeds_in_run_probe_noise gate now measures the paired noise IN-RUN. F3 DECLARED not fixable here: order and dosed-window are perfectly confounded by the ratified sketch, so the classifier favours H-schedule but never disfavours the others on it. D3 (the interleaved arm) IS OWED, NOT QUEUED, and is NOT buildable as sketched: consolidate() takes one schedule per call and interleaves MODULES not DATA WINDOWS, there is no per-step window argument, no mixture-buffer utility exists, and a driver-side n_steps=1 alternation is NOT equivalent because each call builds a fresh per-module Adam. Route D3 to /implement-substrate first. The autopsy's stop rule is attached to D3, not to this ladder, and this run does not discharge it. GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): decisive readout = held-out E1 MSE as a function of FINAL-PASS dose. Checked v3_exq_1048/1057/1057a via reanalysis_query (the only three manifests carrying e1_holdout_mse_early); all three are single whole-life-dose runs, none varies the final pass at all and none carries an intermediate k, and each sits on a different substrate_hash -> NOT RECOVERABLE, run. STEP 2.5b: re-derive brake count 0 for MECH-017 (both predecessor autopsies are instrument defects owing no build, action 'none'), so the brake does not hold. STEP 2.5c: open CORRUPTING entry contextmemory-write-path-addressing-degeneracy (e1_deep.py::ContextMemory.write) is OFF-PATH -- sd016_writepath_mode is 'off', asserted per cell at runtime as a precondition, the same disposition 1057/1057a ran under and the autopsy confirmed. Open DEGRADING overlaps this run touches, recorded per the rule: e2-world-forward-sleep-trainer (why the E2 readout is SELF-forward and non-load-bearing), sd061-resume-progress-ecology (CausalGridWorldV2.step), SD-MECH303-THRESHOLD-SOURCING, SD-ZWORLD-SENSE-PATH-PARITY. SD-091 (REEAgent.select_action) is off-path: the action stream is model-independent. anchor_reachability_lint WARNs (advisory, exit 0) and is LEFT STANDING un-silenced, disposed of in writing: it is scoped to diagnostic purpose, 1057a carries the same precondition set under `evidence` without tripping it, and every inherited anchor has a RECORDED full-scale clearance from 1057/1057a (in the manifest's anchor_reachability_evidence block). Smoke PASS on both the shipped script and a floor-relaxed scratch copy used to exercise the verdict path.
